mBuff.mDescription:
Serpentine GraceCassiopeia gains @f2@ Move Speed (@f1@ per level).

Cassiopeia cannot purchase Boots items.

mLocKeys.keySummary: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cassiopeia gains <speed>@TotalMovementSpeed@ Move Speed</speed> and <scaleAP>@BonusAbilityPower@ Ability Power</scaleAP> but cannot purchase Boots.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Cassiopeia gains @TotalMovementSpeed@ Move Speed and @BonusAbilityPower@ Ability Power but cannot purchase Boots.

This passive has been enhanced by claiming the Feats of Strength.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing @BasicDamage@ magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional @BonusPoisonedDamage@ magic damage and Cassiopeia restores @HealCalc@ Health, reduced to @HealCalcMinion@ Health against lane minions and small monsters.

If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores @Cost@ Mana.

mBuff.mDescription:
Serpentine GraceCassiopeia gains @f2@ Move Speed (@f1@ per level).

Cassiopeia cannot purchase Boots items.

mLocKeys.keySummary: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cassiopeia increases the effectiveness of all <speed>Move Speed</speed> bonuses by @PercentHasteMod@.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Noxious Blast Haste</titleLeft><mainText>Hitting a champion with Noxious Blast has increased Cassiopeia's Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, <keywordMajor>Poisoning</keywordMajor> enemies and dealing <magicDamage>@TooltipTotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoisonDuration@ seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia <speed>@ChampHitMSBonus@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @ChampHitMSDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Noxious Poison</titleLeft><mainText>The unit is taking periodic damage from poison.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Petrifying Gaze Slow</titleLeft><mainText>Petrifying Gaze has slowed this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing <magicDamage>@RDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> enemies facing her for @RCCDuration@ seconds. Enemies facing away are <status>Slowed</status> by @RSlowPercent@% decaying over the same duration instead.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Petrifying Gaze Stun</titleLeft><mainText>Petrifying Gaze has stunned this unit by turning it to stone.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for @CloudDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the clouds take <magicDamage>@DamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second, are <keywordMajor>Poisoned</keywordMajor>, <status>Grounded</status>, and <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowPercent@%.
